session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Broad Bear Channel Inside Trading Range Day' (ET+12 hrs, Apr 29/30). Trading range reversal swing setups throughout the day but many scalps only. Double bottom bear trap at yesterday's low 7144, tight bull channel rally to a parabolic wedge top 7175 (bar 18), broad bear channel decline with sell climax 2nd leg down 7144 (bar 36), midday drift on consecutive wedges along the lower bear channel trendline (support) 7141 before the FOMC statement and press conference, then a 2nd leg up, 2nd entry buy rally that spiked to the Globex high 7190 and collapsed into the close 7137.75. Inset: Market Continuing Broad Trading Range.
